goal: Provide bitcoinkernel consumers structured log entries with direct metadata instead of formatted strings
Free kernel consumers from node-oriented logging baggage like buffering and category toggles
agreement: Support for simplifying kernel logging and adopting structured log entries (ryanofsky, w0xlt)
Unanswered objection: singletons introduce viral coupling across kernel components (purpleKarrot)
Earlier objections on global init logging and memory safety were resolved (ajtowns, w0xlt)
Author agreed to add an assert and doc update regarding null user data handling (musaHaruna)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because bitcoinkernel consumers gain direct access to structured log metadata without string parsing
Removes node-specific logging machinery from the kernel library and helps isolate kernel interfaces
